# ÓE logo color theme

The palette is based on the [Óbudai Egyetem logo used on the university website](https://uni-obuda.hu/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Obudai_Egyetem_OE_LOGO_RGB_inverz.png). The logo image contains royal blue `#00288C` and turquoise `#00DCDC`.

| Role | Light | Dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| App background | `#F3F7FD` | `#000000` |
| Card | `#FFFFFF` | `#071936` |
| Primary action | `#00288C` | `#8DB6FF` |
| Secondary surface / class block | `#E7EFFC` | `#17355C` |
| Accent / shared event | `#DDF6F6` | `#073A55` |
| Text | `#102348` | `#EFF5FF` |
| Border | `#C5D5EA` | `#35567A` |
| Own timetable grid | inherited | `#030D20` |
| Peer timetable grid | inherited | `#07162A` |

`color-v1/` contains the exact pre-redesign source files for restoring the previous theme.
